title: Buffalo: Enabling Large-Scale GNN Training via Memory-Efficient Bucketization
problem: Training GNNs on large graphs using partitioning strategies causes a memory explosion problem driven by the long-tail degree distribution of graph nodes, and suffers from expensive graph partitioning, difficult memory estimation per partition, and slow data preparation (block generation).
motivation: GNNs achieve state-of-the-art results on graph tasks but are memory-limited at large scale (billion-node graphs), and existing partitioning strategies fail to handle the high degree variance that causes unpredictable memory spikes.
method: Buffalo introduces node bucketization: a flexible mapping between nodes and partitions that addresses memory explosion by allowing nodes to be distributed to non-contiguous buckets based on degree, preventing any single partition from holding too many high-degree nodes. Fast graph partitioning is implemented based on node bucketing without requiring expensive global partitioning algorithms. A lightweight analytical model estimates memory consumption per partition before allocation, and graph sampling reduces block generation time during data preparation. Evaluation covers real-world billion-scale GNN datasets.
key_novelty: Node bucketization that flexibly maps high-degree nodes across partitions to eliminate the memory explosion caused by long-tail degree distributions, enabling scalable large-scale GNN training within strict memory budgets.
contributions: Buffalo GNN training system with node bucketization to prevent memory explosion from skewed degree distributions
Fast graph partitioning based on node bucketing avoiding expensive global partitioning
Lightweight analytical model for per-partition memory estimation
Graph-sampling-based block generation reduction; 70.9% average training time reduction vs. DGL, PyG, Betty

metrics.speedup: 70.9% end-to-end training time reduction on average vs. DGL, PyG, Betty
metrics.other: enables training on billion-scale graphs that exceed GPU memory capacity

primary_theme: memory-efficient node bucketization for large-scale GNN training
